# function: size_bytes

Units are binary, as ZFS uses them: `K`, `M`, `G`, `T` and `P` (with optional `iB` or `B`) multiply by 1024, 1024², and so on. A bare number is bytes. The result must be a whole number of bytes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
output "quota" {
  value = provider::truenas::size_bytes("1T") # 1099511627776
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
size_bytes(size string) number
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `size` (String) Size to convert, e.g. `"500M"`.
